violations.text: Buildup of food debris/soil residue on equipment door handles. Rice cooker handle.
Employee beverage container on a food preparation table or over/next to clean equipment/utensils. Bottle of water. Advised to place in an employee area. Employee removed.
Employee personal food not properly identified and segregated from food to be served to the public. Education provided. Operator removed from table top. Found more inside make table cooler.
Employee personal items stored in or above a food preparation area, food, clean equipment and utensils, or single-service items. Cell phone on prep table.
Employee with no hair restraint while engaging in food preparation. Operator.
Exterior door has a gap at the threshold that opens to the outside. Exit door.
Food not stored at least 6 inches off of the floor. Bulk oil on cook line.

Water leaking from condenser in walk in cooler.
Wet wiping cloth not stored in sanitizing solution between uses.

Chlorine sanitizer used to sanitize clean in place equipment not at proper minimum strength. Do not use equipment not properly sanitized. Found at 0 ppm. Operator added more sanitizer. Rechecked and found at 50 ppm. Education provided.

Employee began working with food, handling clean equipment or utensils, or touching unwrapped single-service items without first washing hands. Operator went outside and came into kitchen to prepare order without washing hands. Education provided.

Employee with infected sore/cut/burn/wound on hand, finger or wrist without a single-use glove over an impermeable cover such as a bandage, finger cot or stall covering the wound is handling food, clean equipment or utensils, or unwrapped single-service items. Observed employee on cook line bleeding from hand. It appeared to just happen at start of inspection. Advised to clean and cover area before returning to work. Employee left kitchen area.
